name: PRO4500
description: PRO4500 is a high-powered, truly full-body red and near-infrared light therapy device — Hooga's maximum-coverage panel, designed to deliver an entire body treatment in a single position. At more than 5 feet tall with 900 LEDs, it covers an adult head to toe at once, making it a versatile addition to your daily wellness routine. This panel features 900 dual-chip LEDs emitting 660nm red light and 850nm near-infrared light . The panel has many built in cooling fans, as well as a built in digital timer and a digital control module allowing you to choose from red, near infrared, or both wavelengths of light. It stands more than 5 feet tall, making it one of the largest panels of its kind. It's modular and stand compatible , meaning it can be connected to other devices in the PRO series and it can be attached to either of our mobile stands.
